 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure by the petitioners/accused Nos.4 and 10 to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.110 of 2018 on the file of the XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad, registered for offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 120 (B) read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC') and Sections 38 (2) (3) (4) of A.P. MACS Act, 1995.

entities.text: XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. When the matter is taken up today, Sri Ashok Anand Kumar, learned Senior Counsel appearing for Sri N.Gangadhar, learned counsel for the petitioners, submitted that the controversy involved in the present Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the common order dated 16.10.2023, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.7157 and 7372 of 2023, whereby this Court has quashed the proceedings initiated against accused Nos.1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 22 and 17, and prayed this Court to quash the proceedings against the petitioners herein also.
3. The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1 - State contended that notice has to be issued to respondent No.2, who is de facto complainant in this case.

4. Taking into consideration that the matter is covered by the common order of this Court, there is no necessity to issue any notice to respondent No.2 and as petitioners/accused Nos.4 and 10 are also part of the said Adhoc Body from 2003 to 2007, the same benefit has to be extended to the petitioners herein also.
5.

In view of the aforesaid submission and for the reasons alike in the common order dated 16.10.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.7157 and 7372 of 2023, the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.4 and 10 in C.C.No.110 of 2018 pending on the file of the XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Nampally, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
